name: Scribblenauts Remix Vita
author: clickbate
description: A PS Vita port of the Android version of Scribblenauts Remix, a puzzle game combining content from Scribblenauts and Super Scribblenauts. Players create objects using words to solve puzzles in different ways. Originally developed by 5TH Cell, with the mobile adaptation by Iron Galaxy Studios.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
